name: Cheat Code 1.2.0
notes: Signed release, arm64 only, Android 10 or newer. Adds the bet simulator upgrade: Place Bet buttons on Today and Best, a PrizePicks-style entry builder in Bets, streak/form/milestone gamification, and self-learning from your own record — your settled paper bets feed the same segment analysis as the system, and any rule they imply can be tested as a formula on a fresh simulated season. Paper bets only; no account required.
